dcf99de4: Set up the values for the DIC and DIC(0) nodes in preparation for a FileMan lookup or edit. If the input string contains a 'P', it is assumed to be a FileMan LAYGO reference, so DLAYGO is set from the input string, and control is transferred to the AST^DIED routine if the input string ends with '*'. If the input string does not end with '*', the NOSCR^DIED routine is executed. The value of the variable X is set to the internal FileMan entry number of the selected option. If X is negative, indicating that the lookup was aborted, control is transferred back to the cross-referenced routine 'X'.

c56ecdd4: If the input string does not contain an 'N', jump to the label 'V'. Otherwise, execute the MUMPS command 'D' (which is typically used for date/time manipulation). If the length of the decimal portion of X exceeds 24 characters, delete the value of X. Finally, jump to the label 'Z'.

7f2cea51: ;Store data dictionary information for the current field in the local array DQ. D is the field number, DLB is the label for computed fields, DV is the input transform, DU is the output transform, DW is the word-processing flag, and $T(@("X"_DQ)) retrieves the text of the executable code for the DQ node.

cfb27680: ;If the node DE(DQ) is undefined, execute the label 'O' (for setting defaults). If X is not '@' then goto 'RD'. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', goto 'A'. If X is '@', goto the label 'X'. Set X to the value of Y and goto 'N'.
c630ab47: ;Store the input transform (DV) in DG. Set Y to the value of DE(DQ) and X to the output transform (DU). If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute the code stored there. Then goto 'RP'.

de03647f: ;If DG contains 'P' and the global node ^(0) exists, set X to the second piece of ^(0) (the internal entry number). If the node ^(Y,0) is undefined, goto 'RP'. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of ^(Y,0) (the external value), X to the third piece of the .01 field of the data dictionary, and DG to the second piece of ^(Y,0) (the internal value). Then goto 'R'.

3ed6745f: ;If DG contains 'V', Y is non-zero, the second piece of Y contains '(', and the global node referenced by the second piece of Y exists, set X to the second piece of ^(0) (the internal entry number). If the node ^(+Y,0) is undefined, goto 'RP'. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of ^(+Y,0) (the external value). If the .01 field of the data dictionary exists, set DG to the second piece (the internal value) and X to the third piece (the external value). Then goto 'R'.
